test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On 15 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Heba __dropped of the club unexpectedly__ to say hello and catch up.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. dropped by the club unexpectedly .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrasal verb **"dropped of"** is incorrect in this context. It should be "dropped by," which means to come for a brief, casual visit.
 
• The word **"by"** is used correctly to indicate stopping somewhere briefly.
 
• The correct phrase should be "dropped by the club unexpectedly."

Correct sentence: *Heba dropped by the club unexpectedly to say hello and catch up.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Phrasal Verbs Examples:**

 
 
• **Drop off:** Leave someone or something at a particular place. Example: Can you drop me off at the station?
 
• **Drop out:** Withdraw from a social group or a chosen course of action. Example: She decided to drop out of college.
 
• **Drop in:** Visit informally. Example: She decided to drop in for a chat.
